prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Google Apps Script Programmer
Hey there, we are a booking and management agency working with a small roster of musicians. To optimize internal processes we have built a tool in Google Spreadsheet, using Chrome browser to automize our contracting and invoicing. For a few last steps and programming tasks in Apps Script we are looking for someone who can help us with the following tasks:- Checking up on and optimizing our self-built Excel Booking System- Issuing possible connections to further Sheets- Programming consecutive invoice- and contract numbers in our Google Sheet- Contracts and invoices must automatically be saved in the particularly allocated folders as PDFs- Developing an Excel contact management Sheet, tailored to our needsBudget: $500Posted On: February 22, 2024 12:55 UTCCategory: Scripting & AutomationSkills:Microsoft Excel, Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, Google Chrome Extension, Google APIsSkills: Microsoft Excel, Google Apps Script, Google Sheets, Google Chrome Extension, Google APIsCountry: Germanyclick to apply
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.
- End with one specific question about the job.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need help optimizing your Google Sheets booking system and finishing the Apps Script automation for invoice/contract numbering, PDF saving, and a tailored contact management sheet.  

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, Google Sheets, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization. I can help review your current spreadsheet setup, improve the structure, and build the Apps Script logic needed to connect sheets, generate consecutive invoice and contract numbers, and automatically save contracts and invoices as PDFs in the correct folders. I can also help design a clean contact management sheet that fits your workflow.  

If you’d like, I can focus first on the numbering and PDF automation, then move to the contact sheet and system cleanup.  

Would you like me to work from your existing sheet structure, or should I propose a cleaner layout first?
